description:
Cast Star of Extinction by paying {5}{R}{R}, destroying target land and dealing 20 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
Toralf triggers for each creature your opponent control that is dealt excess damage this way.
Resolve a Toralf trigger, dealing damage equal to the excess damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.

uses.name: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer
